posts.title: New Book of Names
posts.description: I've used EBon, the Everlasting Book of Names by Sami Pyörre for decades to help me with names. It came out when I started to work on Greyhawk maps in the late 1990's, and it came with the ability to create Greyhawk names built in. I love the thing, and used it all the time. […]
